name: viewer: one stop per trigger, not per row
why: A year row has up to four triggers; Shift+→ must go to the next row, not to the same row's next icon.

name: glyph: it gets the lazy cell's sort key
why: The Title glyph must have no text: a sort key there would change how Title sorts and what a Title filter reads.

why: The glyph links the song's page and holds no , so without its own skip _dpSiteForLink() would preview it.

name: glyph: a page with no images keeps its glyph
why: State none is display: none (CSS); without it a song read as having no images still shows its dashed glyph.

name: sweep: Brucebase is not swept
why: _fiAfterRender() paints the glyphs of songs read in an earlier session from the database (no request).

why: On touch there is no hover; the tap is the only way in and must open the viewer, not the page.
